title: I Have Not Appreciated What You Have
summary: Gratitude is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; only
lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; only
source.lifeApplication: Gratitude becomes more truthful when i have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; only.

evidence.coreClaim: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; only
evidence.turn: Real gratitude does not inflate the self. It softens it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
